title: ChatDS4
description: The plugin changes the chat on your server! Depending on how far you are from another player, messages in the chat will appear blurry to other players!!
body: **The plugin changes the chat on your server!** Depending on how far you are from another _player_, the messages in the chat will appear unclear to _players_ on your server. For example: you wrote in the chat **'Hello World'**; the nearest players will see it exactly as you wrote it, but _players_ who are, for example, **100 blocks** away from you will not understand your message at all. For them, it will appear like this: _######_
